answer: Each admitted identity stands on 160 locked units: four hop signers from four invite subtrees each lock 40 units for 8 epochs behind the signed signal that must complete the voyage to the applicant's vertex, its single graph node. A farm fielding 1,000 vertices needs 4,000 distinct signers and 160,000 locked units; a signer spent on one vertex cannot carry a second signal that epoch. Verifiers replay the hop chain and check each signature's subtree root; two signals sharing a signer in one epoch void both admissions and burn that hop's 40. Sponsors recover the lock after 8 clean epochs.
